description: Configure the MariaDB database server to allow remote connections. Specifically, change the MySQL/MariaDB server configuration to listen on all network interfaces (0.0.0.0) instead of just localhost. Then, grant the existing database user 'acmecorp' permission to connect to the database from the remote IP address '192.168.100.55'. Do not allow access from any other remote IP. Ensure the database server is restarted so changes take effect.
